comparison.evidence_sentence: Patients with RA were more likely to be female and had more comorbidities than patients without RA.

uncertainty.evidence_sentence: A total of 947 variants were detected in the SLC12A3 gene, the majority of which were classified as of uncertain significance.

blinded_source_only_reviews.rationale: The explicit full cohort spans already preserve RA-positive and RA-negative membership. Separate links are a faithful projection, but not another asserted finding.
The source truth is the comparison between explicitly named cohorts; requiring decomposed RA relations would be an evaluation or schema preference.

source_general_rule: A restrictive condition must remain in the machine-readable representation when deleting or substituting it changes the extension, denominator, qualifier, or truth conditions of a role-bearing participant inherited by the focused event. A complete role-bearing participant span is itself the custody carrier when it already contains that restriction. Create a separate typed scope relation only when the valid participant occurrence does not contain a material condition needed to resolve an anaphor, aggregate, ellipsis, or downstream event argument; require exact, fail-closed occurrence custody and do not convert the relation into an event argument.

adjudicated_findings.accepted_v17_uncertainty_representation: One typed occurrence-bound cohort-to-locus participant scope link plus one MAJORITY qualifier on the existing affected event argument.

reconciliation_of_sealed_history.v15_post_run_classification: The V15 source-only conclusion that a direct classification-to-gene argument is optional is preserved.
reconciliation_of_sealed_history.v16_source_scope_tiebreak: The V16 conclusion that the cohort-to-locus scope link and the majority qualifier are mandatory for the anaphoric aggregate is preserved.
reconciliation_of_sealed_history.resolution: These conclusions address different structures. A direct event argument is not required, but a non-inline condition needed to resolve the inherited variant cohort is required. Conversely, RA is already retained within both complete comparison-parent spans and must not be decomposed merely because it is named.

minimum_fail_closed_matrix: A shortened comparison parent that omits with RA or without RA fails complete participant denotation.
A comparison with complete parent spans and no RA child nodes or scope links passes the V17 inline-scope boundary.
A comparison RA node or link that treats RA as an ordinary OUTCOME participant fails; V17 has no optional inline-scope schema capability.
A bare 947-variant cohort with no locus scope link fails.
A direct classification-to-locus edge with no cohort scope link fails.
A classification of all 947 variants with no explicit majority qualifier fails.
An unanchored, method-occurrence, duplicate, reversed, wrong-role, or untypeable scope representation fails.
A correctly anchored locus scope link and majority qualifier pass without a direct classification-to-locus edge.
